user.title: Add a device
user.description: Convert a SmartIR JSON code file, or paste a profile code that was already generated.

device.title: Set up the entity
device.description: Choose the Infrared emitter that controls this device. You can also choose an optional receiver to synchronize state when the physical remote is used.

data_description.carrier_frequency: The modulation frequency sent to the IR emitter. Leave it at 38 kHz unless the device requires a different carrier frequency.
data_description.timing_scale: Scales every pulse and gap sent by this entity. Leave it at 100% unless a transmitter needs timing compensation.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Room temperature shown on the climate card.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Room humidity shown on the climate card.
data_description.power_sensor: A binary sensor that reports whether the appliance is really on.
data_description.power_sensor_restore_state: Re-apply the last state when Home Assistant restarts.

reconfigure.title: Update Irabelle Universal Remote device
reconfigure.description: View or replace the IRP1 profile code, and change the name, emitter, or optional receiver. The replacement profile must use the same device type.

data_description.profile_code: Paste a complete IRP1 code for the same type of device.
data_description.carrier_frequency: The modulation frequency sent to the IR emitter. Leave it at 38 kHz unless the device requires a different carrier frequency.
data_description.timing_scale: Scales every pulse and gap sent by this entity. Leave it at 100% unless a transmitter needs timing compensation.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Room temperature shown on the climate card.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Room humidity shown on the climate card.
data_description.power_sensor: A binary sensor that reports whether the appliance is really on.
data_description.power_sensor_restore_state: Re-apply the last state when Home Assistant restarts.

profile_code.title: Paste the profile code
profile_code.description: Create and copy a profile code from the SmartIR converter website, then paste it below.

data_description.profile_code: A code beginning with IRP1: generated locally by the converter website.

smartir_json.title: SmartIR JSON device file
smartir_json.description: Upload the SmartIR JSON file for your device, or paste its contents. The converter website is not needed: the file is converted here, with the correct entity type detected automatically.

data_description.smartir_json_file: A code file such as climate/1280.json from a SmartIR code repository.
data_description.smartir_json_text: Used when no file is uploaded. The whole JSON file must be pasted.

code_library.title: Code library
code_library.description: Search the published code library by brand and model, like the phone app. Point it at the library repository (or a local copy of it) — pinyin works too, so "fushitong" finds Fujitsu. The index is downloaded once and cached; only the chosen device's bundle is fetched.

data_description.library_url: An https:// URL, or a folder such as /config/smartir_codes holding index.json.gz and bundles/.
data_description.library_brand: Leave empty to list everything indexed. A model typed here still matches.
data_description.library_model: Narrows the results, for example the model on your remote's label.
data_description.library_appliance: The kind of device: air conditioner, TV, set-top box, and so on.

code_library_select.title: Choose the device
code_library_select.description: {result_count} Pick the entry that matches your device. Air conditioners appear as climate entities; a full code set lists its modes and range, while a button remote steps one degree at a time.

data_description.library_choice: The chosen device is fetched and converted into a profile.

test.title: Test the device
test.description: {position} Testing {device} through {emitter}. {capabilities} {sent} {error} Press a button and watch the appliance - every mode, fan speed and swing state the code set has is offered.

menu_options.test_create_provisional: Create it and test with the real card

code_library_emitter.title: Infrared emitter
code_library_emitter.description: Choose the emitter that will transmit. Every code test and the finished device use it, so pick the one that can reach the appliance.

data_description.infrared_entity_id: The infrared emitter entity that sends the codes.
data_description.infrared_receiver_entity_id: Optional: learn from the physical remote and keep the state in sync.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Room temperature shown on the climate card.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Room humidity shown on the climate card.
data_description.power_sensor: A binary sensor that reports whether the appliance is really on.
data_description.power_sensor_restore_state: Re-apply the last state when Home Assistant restarts.

test_mode.title: Send a mode
test_mode.description: Modes in this code set: {modes}. Pick one and watch the appliance.

test_fan.title: Send a fan speed
test_fan.description: Fan speeds in this code set: {fans}. Pick one and watch the appliance.

test_swing.title: Send a swing state
test_swing.description: Swing states in this code set: {swings}. Pick one and watch the appliance.

init.title: Edit Irabelle Universal Remote device
init.description: Change the emitter, the carrier frequency or timing scale, and the optional room and power sensors. The name and the profile code are edited from Reconfigure.

data_description.carrier_frequency: The modulation frequency sent to the IR emitter. Leave it at 38 kHz unless the device requires a different carrier frequency.
data_description.timing_scale: Scales every pulse and gap sent by this entity. Leave it at 100% unless a transmitter needs timing compensation.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Room temperature shown on the climate card.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Room humidity shown on the climate card.
data_description.power_sensor: A binary sensor that reports whether the appliance is really on.
data_description.power_sensor_restore_state: Re-apply the last state when Home Assistant restarts.

error.invalid_profile: The profile code is invalid or unsupported. Generate it again and paste the complete code.
error.profile_type_mismatch: The replacement profile is for a different device type. Add it as a new Irabelle Universal Remote device instead.
error.invalid_smartir_json: That SmartIR file could not be used: {error}
error.library_unavailable: The code library could not be read: {error}
error.library_device_invalid: That library device could not be converted: {error}
error.test_failed: The test command could not be sent: {error}
error.no_test_command: This profile has no power command to test with.
error.no_more_candidates: That was the last code set for this search - widen the brand or model to see more.

abort.no_infrared_emitters: No Home Assistant Infrared emitter entity is available.
abort.invalid_profile: The profile setup session expired. Start adding the integration again.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Irabelle Universal Remote device was updated successfully.
abort.library_expired: The library search expired. Start adding the integration again.

create_entry.smartir_native_off_filled: The file did not contain an off command, so {frame} was added. If the device does not turn off, learn the off command from the remote and replace the profile.
